title: Simulating multiple human perspectives in socio-ecological systems using large language models
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a modeling framework (HoPeS) for socio-ecological systems using LLM-powered agents to simulate stakeholder perspectives. While it references moral judgment and ethical dilemmas as theoretical motivations for perspective-shifting, the core research and illustrative experiments are centered on land-use governance, budget allocation, and institutional dynamics rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethics, morality, or religion.
